Minimum API 26; compile/target API 35; JDK 17.
Manual Android packaging, javac, D8, zipalign and APK v2/v3 verification passed.

Behavior:
- Full-screen camera viewing reads only GetThumb (0x100A), at most 4 MiB.
- Preview errors, absent support, malformed or oversized data never fall back to GetObject.
- Two pinned preview files / 8 MiB; their actual thumbnail lengths are validated
  independently of the original JPEG byte size. Original size does not limit preview.
- Cached grid bitmap is shown immediately. The viewer may request one additional
  GetThumb to retain the camera-supplied thumbnail's available resolution.
- Preview status labels displayed pixel dimensions. No 2 MP or medium-preview claim.
- Download original is explicit GetObject (0x1009), independently validated/saved;
  thumbnail cache is never copied as an original, including after disconnecting.
- The downloaded local original replaces the preview while preserving the same
  photo's relative zoom and normalized center. New photo opens reset the transform.
- Offline previews cannot enable downloading. Old batch results are not shown on
  the next photo's preview. Immersive controls, fit/zoom and grid return remain.

148 storage, 955 read-only directory, 50 Picture Control codec, 77 adaptation,
2845 PTP/IP, 50 thumbnail-cache, 101 pagination, 47 production album flow checks.
The production album suite compiles real AlbumController and PtpIpClient, stubbing
only Android Context/Handler and Wi-Fi routing. It verifies zero GetObject during
preview; explicit download requests and stores original bytes; large originals can
be previewed; missing/rejected/malformed/oversized thumbnails have no original
fallback; disconnected thumbnail data cannot be saved as an original.
tests/run-album.ps1 also passed independently (the same 47, not added twice).
The last UI-only status fix does not alter these tested classes.
Independent correctness review found no required fixes. git diff --check passed.

Limits:
No physical-camera wireless session or actual camera photo corpus was used.
Preview quality depends on what the camera returns to GetThumb; no Nikon-specific
medium-resolution API, 2 MP preview, RAW/video support or SnapBridge-equivalence
is claimed. Physical-phone album gestures, hardware pinch, TalkBack, tablets and
weak-network performance were not verified. Earlier version evidence retains its
original scope, and prior USB/library checks are not counted as newly run here.
